links.comparator_used: LLMs alone (AI acting alone) on real-world infectious disease cases
links.outcome: Completeness of clinical decision responses (expert Likert ratings)
links.effect: Doctors supported by LLMs scored significantly higher than LLMs alone (p = 0.0010) and than doctors alone (p = 0.0015)
links.quote: Notably, for completeness, doctors supported by LLMs achieved significantly higher scores compared with both doctors alone (p = 0.0015) and the LLMs alone (p = 0.0010).
